title: Bench Runs (archived, pick a run)
description: Generated by scripts/dashboards/build.py --runs — do not edit by hand. Full-fidelity view of one archived run at a time: the real scraped TSDB that scripts/prom_archive.sh merged into bench-replay-data, not a dump.json reconstruction. Pick a run from the 'Run' dropdown; every panel re-queries that run's own window through a PromQL offset, so all runs share one axis starting at their t0, and stops at that run's own end. Leave the time range alone. Requires the marker series from scripts/run_markers.py. For overlaying several runs in one panel, use the Bench Replay dashboard instead.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: Which archived run every panel shows. The value is the run's distance from the dashboard's fixed anchor, applied as a PromQL offset.

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint & method
panels.description: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count)) by (uri, method). Replaces the separate per-family throughput panels the three old dashboards each had.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="$job"}[1m] offset $run)) by (uri, method)) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))

panels.title: POST /inventory/orders by status
panels.description: Admission outcome. On archived runs only the 202/non-202 split survives.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[1m] offset $run)) by (le, uri, method))) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))
(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[1m] offset $run)) by (le, uri, method))) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))
(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[1m] offset $run)) by (le, uri, method))) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))
(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="$job",status=~"[45].."}[1m] offset $run)) by (uri, status)) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))

panels.title: Offered vs accepted vs terminal
panels.description: One axis, orders/s. Dashed = asked of the system, solid = done by it.

panels.title: In-flight orders (saturation)
panels.description: Admitted minus terminal. Monotonic growth on a constant-rate plateau is saturation.

targets.expr: ((sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="$job",method="POST",uri="/inventory/orders",status="202"} offset $run) or vector(0)) - (sum(order_e2e_time_seconds_count{job="$job"} offset $run) or vector(0))) and on() (vector(time()) < vector($end))
